tmp:3487: achor — 'behind' of Psalms 139:5, symbol of the reversed order (tashrak alphabet), the not-in-sequence aspect linked to Chavah/Malkhut; not the body's back per se
tmp:3488: tashrak — the alphabet recited in reverse order (tav-shin-resh-kuf), emblem of 'not in order' / achor
tmp:3491: milui — fullness/completion of a thing, identified with its vitality (chiyut); the state of being whole through connection to God, not a letter-filling spelling
tmp:3492: dalet-vav-yud — the letters of the spelled-out yud (yu"d), Chokhmah's vitality drawn into Malkhut-dalet; a letter-filling, not 'illness' (dvai)
tmp:3493: kaf — the letter kaf as numerical value 20, from the al-tikrei reading of 'kapekha' (Ps 139:5), equal to yud's gematria doubled into Malkhut
tmp:3494: the letter dalet — letter-symbol of Malkhut who 'has nothing of her own' (dal, poor) until receiving the yud of Chokhmah
tmp:3495: a thing drawn down from a high place — an occurrence whose root is in an exalted supernal source, which therefore may arrive below 'not in order'
tmp:3496: shevi — the captivity/captive of Deut 21:10 ('and you take its captives'), the opposing will taken captive and subdued in the inner war
tmp:3497: binding His divinity into your thought — the contemplative act of attaching awareness of God to one's mind during opposition
tmp:3498: the nullification of all wars and all wills opposing your will — the promised state of 'Hashem delivers him into your hand'
tmp:3499: milchamah — war defined as opposition of wills, the existential aspect of 'not in order'; the war of Deut 21:10 read inwardly
tmp:3501: his blood is spilled — suffering shame/humiliation as literal bloodshed (the blood draining from the face), functioning as slaughter of the self
tmp:3502: zera merei'im — 'seed of evildoers' (Isaiah 1:4), the corrupt brood/external passions assailing the heart, akin to the flood-waters
tmp:3503: the waters of the Flood (mabul) — archetype of the overwhelming 'many waters' of alien loves and fears
tmp:3504: mayim rabbim — the 'many waters' of Song 8:7 that cannot quench love: external loves and fears threatening the heart's holy ardor
tmp:3505: external loves and fears — fallen, outward ahavot and yir'ot (the 'many waters') opposed to holy love and awe of God
tmp:3506: shin — the letter shin of 'Shabbat' (shin + bat), whose three strokes signify the three elements fire, wind, water
tmp:3507: fire, wind, water — the three primal elements (telat gevanin) symbolized by the three heads of the letter shin
tmp:3509: the holy body from the Garden of Eden — the pure 'Shabbat-garment' body donned after stripping the leprous serpent-skin body
tmp:3510: the fallen souls — souls that have no ascent except through the spilled blood (shaming/martyrdom) of Israel
tmp:3511: kisui ha-dam — the ritual covering of blood, read as the Shekhinah covering Israel's blood spilled through shame borne in love
tmp:3512: shefikhut damim — spilling of blood: shame/humiliation as bloodshed serving as the 'shechitah' that permits the tzaddik's mitzvot to be 'tasted'
tmp:3514: the holiness of Shabbat — identified with 'the ultimate of knowing is that we do not know,' the takhlit of heaven and earth
tmp:3518: the three vavs — 3×6=18, the chai (eighteen) blessings of the Amidah as 'arrows' shot from the bow of the rectified brit
tmp:3519: connection and cleaving (devekut) to God — the essential attachment to the Blessed One attained through the gate of prayer
tmp:3521: the renewal of the oath to the Patriarchs — the sworn covenant to the Avot reawakened/re-established through prayer's power
tmp:3522: the rectification (tikkun) of the Shekhinah — restoring Malkhut from her darkened exile state
tmp:3523: the upholding/establishing of the covenant (brit) — making the brit stand firm, linked to 'u-vriti ne'emenet lo'
tmp:3524: eshet chayil — the 'Woman of Valor' (Proverbs 31) as a name of Malkhut to be rectified through the strength God gives
tmp:3525: 'you shall rectify the eshet chayil' — the act of repairing Malkhut through the koach (strength) of Deut 8:18, read as la'asot chayil
tmp:3528: his shoulders — the shoulders as anatomical locus in the partzuf-scheme, the region behind/below the neck associated with Leah at the oref
tmp:3529: the aspect of Leah — the first nukva (feminine partzuf) positioned at the oref (back of the head/neck), alluded to by luzim-nuts
tmp:3530: the aspect of Rachel — the second, lower feminine partzuf, counterpart to Leah of the oref
tmp:3531: beitzah — an egg, the enclosed shell-covered form likened to the nut/luz in this imagery of hidden inner content
tmp:3533: Beit El — the place Jacob named 'House of God' (identified with the Temple), entered by way of the city Luz
tmp:3534: entering the Beit HaMikdash — the act of coming into the Holy Temple (Beit El) by first passing through Luz/Leah
tmp:3535: nuts called luzim — the egozim/luz-nuts (hazelnuts) whose name alludes to the city Luz and to Leah at the oref
tmp:3540: the essence of our consolation — the core nechamah, rooted in 'nachamu nachamu' whose double gematria equals kodkod (crown of the head)
tmp:3541: Shabbat Nachamu — the Sabbath after Tisha B'Av when Isaiah 40:1 'Nachamu nachamu' is read, Shabbat of consolation
tmp:3542: ma'arikh rucho — patiently extending one's spirit: forbearing endurance in divine service, the counterpart to needing harsh fasts
